g.text: Each extra bit only ever halves the previous step size, so the Nth category
always bisects the LARGEST remaining gap on the circle — the minimum gap
between any n assigned hues never drops below half of the ideal 360/n
ceiling, and hits that ceiling exactly whenever n is a power of two
(proven for n up to 64 in cover-hue.test.ts).
sequence, not a small finite one — its worst-case minimum gap for the
handful of categories a personal blog actually has computes to only ~38%
of the 360/n ceiling, worse than van der Corput's guaranteed 50%.
